race.title: Colm Quinn BMW Novice Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: A cleaner round of jumping can see unexposed GOMEZ ADDAMS make it 2 wins from 3 starts over hurdles. Crystabel may be the main danger if allowed to dictate, while there could be more to come from Bunker Buster if putting it all together. GOMEZ ADDAMS (IRE) CRYSTABEL (IRE) BUNKER BUSTER (IRE)
